subject: animal (ectotherm) at a fixed soil depth

messages.author: 54d4981d6bf68eaf
messages.subject: animal (ectotherm) at a fixed soil depth
parts:
Hi all,

I am trying to simulate a newt species at a fixed depth to explore exposure to thermal stress, because it is not clear the extent to which they thermoregulate e.g. during hibernation. I have set live=0 to turn off behavioral thermoregulation. However, I haven't figured out how could I calculate body temperatures at specific soil depths, other than at the surface.

Thanks in advance!
All the best,
Urtzi

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: animal (ectotherm) at a fixed soil depth
parts:
Hi Urtzi,

Here's an example for how to put them at the deepest depth (node 10):

ecto <- ectotherm(mindepth = 10, maxdepth = 10, diurn = 0, nocturn = 0, crepus = 0)

All the best,
Mike
